items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The inline AniBT loading mark: an <output role=status> with a spinning glyph that follows the surrounding ink.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: AniBT 「贴纸手账」 button: candy primary with gloss and a ✦ on hover, raised secondary, quiet ghost, red danger, link and field paints on shadcn's variant and size names, with a non-resizing loading state.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: AniBT tags (neutral, resolution, language, status words), die-cut stickers (paper, candy, water), counts, plus StatusBadge (dot + word) and StatusDot.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: AniBT panel: paper with a 1px edge and the panel shadow (or a flat well), A's 16/12 box with a compact density, and a stitched header or footer.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: AniBT 「贴纸手账」 dialog: the floating paper over the scrim, A's 48px stitched header bar with a quiet close square, a pinned header and footer and one scrolling DialogBody.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: AniBT question dialog: the stitched bar with A's 24px tinted mark (AlertDialogMedia), the quiet cancel left of a candy or red action, shadcn's size / variant props.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: One-call confirmation on @anibt/alert-dialog: red mark and danger key for destructive actions, and an onConfirm promise that keeps the dialog open and busy until it settles.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: AniBT menu: the floating panel with 32px rows that take the pink wash, stitched separators, red destructive rows, pink ticks and dots, submenus and round-face shortcuts.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: AniBT popover: the floating paper anchored to its trigger, with a 14/700 title and a muted description.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: AniBT preview card for a link under a resting pointer (a fansub group, a show), on the floating paper.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>
